Custom-built gaming/workstation PC. Beautiful, fast machine - meticulously built and runs flawlessly. Handles 4K gaming and heavy workloads (rendering, AI, editing) with ease. Fresh Windows install, ready to go.

•	GPU: NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti Founders Edition (24GB) — scarce FE card

•	Cooling: NZXT Kraken AIO liquid cooler 

•	PSU: Lian Li SP850 V2 850W 80+ Gold (SFX, fully modular)

•	Case: Lian Li with 9× Lian Li UNI FAN SL

Collection only - welcome to test before buying.
